title: [Master]-Reverse Charge VAT with 100% Non-Deductible VAT Posts Incorrectly in Foreign Currency Transactions.
summary: Fixed incorrect posting of 100% non-deductible VAT with reverse charge in foreign currency transactions where rounding was applied despite the VAT posting condition not being met.
key_points: Corrected VAT posting logic for reverse charge transactions with 100% non-deductible VAT
Fixed rounding behavior in foreign currency scenarios
Added comprehensive test coverage for non-deductible VAT journal scenarios
quote: for reverse charge vat the condition of vat posting in the transaction is not executed but the rounding is done.
